arxiv-2405-11401.title: PDE Control Gym: A Benchmark for Data-Driven Boundary Control of Partial Differential Equations
arxiv-2405-11401.creator: Luke Bhan, Yuexin Bian, Miroslav Krstic, Yuanyuan Shi
arxiv-2405-11401.description: Abstract Over the last decade, data-driven methods have surged in popularity, emerging as valuable tools for control theory. As such, neural network approximations of control feedback laws, system dynamics, and even Lyapunov functions have attracted growing attention. With the ascent of learning based control, the need for accurate, fast, and easy-to-use benchmarks has increased.

arxiv-2408-06062.title: On Tables with Numbers, with Numbers
arxiv-2408-06062.creator: Konstantinos Kogkalidis, Stergios Chatzikyriakidis
arxiv-2408-06062.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Konstantinos Kogkalidis, Stergios Chatzikyriakidis. This paper is a critical reflection on the epistemic culture of contemporary computational linguistics, framed in the context of its growing obsession with tables with numbers. We argue against tables with numbers on the basis of their epistemic irrelevance, their environmental impact, their role in enabling and exacerbating social inequalities, and their deep ties to commercial applications and profit-driven research. We substantiate our arguments with empirical evidence drawn from a meta-analysis of computational linguistics research over the last decade.

With data from the upcoming LSST survey, we anticipate using a sample of 𝒪 ⁡ ( 1000 ) \mathcal{O}(1000) lensed AGN for TDC.

arxiv-2510-23029.title: Exploring the accelerating black holes from the observations of quasi-periodic oscillations in X-ray binaries
arxiv-2510-23029.creator: Hamza Rehman a,b,c, Saddam Hussain a,b, G. Abbas d, Tao Zhu a,b
arxiv-2510-23029.description: Abstract Black holes in dense astrophysical environments, such as globular clusters or in the vicinity of other massive objects, may possess accelerations. Such acceleration would modulate the characteristics of the quasi-periodic oscillations (QPOs) observed in X-ray black hole binaries. In this paper, we explore the influence of spin-aligned acceleration of a black hole on QPOs observed in X-ray binaries.

pmc-10617509.creator: Anna C. Zemke, Emily J. D'Amico, Angela M. Torres, Grace P. Carreno-Florez, Patrick Keeley, Matt DuPont, Naomi Kasturiarachi, Jennifer M. Bomberger

pmc-13090668.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Autoimmune hepatitis (AIH) is a rare, chronic, immune mediated liver disorder with unknown origin, associated with elevation of serum transaminases and IgG, positivity of certain autoantibodies and characteristic histopathological alterations in the liver. The clinical scenario is variable, the disease can be asymptomatic for a long time, noticed accidently by liver enzyme elevation or diagnosed only when liver cirrhosis has already developed. In rare cases acute hepatitis with liver failure is the starting event.
